name: Comedy & Skits
label: Comedy
description: Short sketches, relatable POV jokes and parody skits that hold attention in the first second.
rationale: Comedy and entertainment content shows the highest Shorts engagement rate in the 2025 Statista figures cited by ShortsIntel (search-snippet level). Virlo tracks 'Micro-documentary format' (+115%) as a rising format, and Teleprompter names short storytelling with a clear payoff as a top niche (June 2026).

name: Gaming
label: Gaming
description: Highlights, clutch plays, reviews and game-update breakdowns from the biggest gaming communities.
rationale: Tubular Labs ranks gaming as the second most-viewed YouTube category by US creators in 2025 (about 361 billion views), and gaming Shorts views rose 17% per video in Apr-May 2025. The Teleprompter June 2026 guide names gaming highlights tied to big releases as a top niche.

name: Food & Recipes
label: Food
description: Quick recipes, satisfying cooking builds, street food and meal prep under 60 seconds.
rationale: Tubular Labs reports Food and Drink has the highest engagement rate of all TikTok categories it measured. Metricool's category taxonomy lists Alimentation and boissons, and Teleprompter names simple, satisfying food builds as a top niche (June 2026).

name: Fitness & Gym
label: Fitness
description: Gym workouts, form fixes, strength training and home routines with visible progress.
rationale: Teleprompter (June 2026) names fitness form fixes and mobility mini-coaching as top-performing formats. ContHunt trending shows 'Strength Training for Women' rising (up1) on 2026-10-14. Metricool groups Santé with Fitness as a category.

name: Beauty & Skincare
label: Beauty
description: Skincare routines, makeup tutorials and ingredient-led product reviews.
rationale: Beauty is a core TikTok Creative Center category (Beauté and soins in the Metricool taxonomy). Tubular Labs reports beauty brands (Cetaphil, Nivea, Sephora) partner with creators on TikTok at up to 3.2x their standard engagement. ContHunt trending shows 'Hypochlorous Acid Spray' rising fast (up2) and 'Beauty-Meets-Wellness' rising (up1).

name: Tech & Gadgets
label: Tech
description: AI tool walkthroughs, gadget reviews and practical software tutorials.
rationale: Virlo's June 2026 tracker ranks 'AI tool walkthroughs' first at +340% over 30 days across TikTok, Shorts and Reels (pooled). ContHunt trending shows 'AI Video Generators' (up2) and 'AI Guardrails' (up2). Metricool lists Tech and electronics as a category.

name: Personal Finance
label: Finance
description: Budgeting, investing basics, savings and money mistakes explained in plain language.
rationale: Finance and business niches carry the highest RPMs on YouTube Shorts (Gyre and Clipspeed, search-snippet level). Teleprompter names personal finance basics as a top niche (June 2026). Virlo tracks 'Financial independence reboot' at +155%. ContHunt trending shows 'AI-Driven Personal Finance' rising (up1).

name: Dance & Music
label: Dance
description: Choreography trends, remix edits and sound-led videos built around one audio hook.
rationale: Virlo's June 2026 tracker lists 'Sound-reactive content' at +70% over 30 days (pooled across platforms). Metricool's taxonomy has no dedicated dance category, so this niche combines dance and music. Evidence is thin, so treat its ranking as provisional.

name: Lifestyle & Vlogs
label: Lifestyle
description: Day-in-my-life vlogs, routines, apartment tours and everyday aesthetics.
search_query: day in my life vlog routine
rationale: Lifestyle was named in the owner brief as a core niche. Virlo's June 2026 tracker lists 'Workplace reality content' (+130%) and 'Founder-mode content' (+210%) as rising. Metricool's category list has no lifestyle entry, so this niche is partly editorial.

label: Cars
